I have completed the database migrations for Keystone.
- `users` table now has a `role` column.
- `properties`, `leases`, and `documents` tables are ready.
- You can now start implementing the Eloquent models and basic controllers for `GET /api/properties`, `GET /api/leases`, and `POST /api/documents/upload`.
- Please ensure you use the correct foreign keys defined in the migrations.
